title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement:
Five runners completed the grueling Xmarathon: Luke, Melina, Nico, Olympia, and Pedro.

• Nico finished \(11\) minutes behind Pedro.

• Olympia finished \(2\) minutes ahead of Melina, but \(3\) minutes behind Pedro.

• Olympia finished \(6\) minutes ahead of Luke.

Which runner finished fourth?

solutions.text: Measure finish times in minutes after Pedro. Then Pedro is at \(0\), Olympia is at \(3\), Melina is at \(5\), Luke is at \(9\), and Nico is at \(11\). The fourth finisher is Luke.
hints: Measure all finish times relative to Pedro
Olympia is \(3\) minutes behind Pedro; Melina and Luke are after Olympia
